
## Branch Naming Convention

```
<your-username>/<type>/<max-4-word-description>
```

---

### Example:

* `nopejs/feat/login-page`
* `nopejs/fix/json-parse`
* `nopejs/chore/update-readme`

---

### Common `<type>`

* `feat` = new feature
* `fix` = bug fix
* `hotfix` = urgent production fix
* `chore` = cleanup, dependencies, tooling
* `refactor` = internal restructuring
* `docs` = documentation
* `test` = tests

---
